readmeExcerpt:
# U3 SDK

Source code for [Unturned](https://smartlydressedgames.com/unturned/), a free open-world zombie survival sandbox game.

## Getting Started

1. Download/clone this repository
2. Install [Unity Hub](https://unity.com/download) (required to install engine)
3. Install the [Unity 2022.3.62f3](https://unity.com/releases/editor/whats-new/2022.3.62f3) editor
4. *Optional*: if making code changes, select **Game development with Unity** + **.NET desktop development** in the Visual Studio installer
5. Ensure Steam is running and you have [Unturned](https://store.steampowered.com/app/304930/Unturned/) installed (large binary files and mods are loaded from here)
6. Open the project with the Unity editor
7. Open the `Assets/GameStartup.unity` scene
8. Click play!

## Resources

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://docs.smartlydressedgames.com/en/stable/u3-sdk/faq.html)
- [Source Code Demo: Adding a Heat-Seeking Missile on YouTube](https://youtu.be/CqJnkcWfmEY)
- [Unturned's Modding Documentation](https://docs.smartlydressedgames.com/en/stable/)

aiSummary.oneLiner: The official source code and Unity-based SDK for the Unturned zombie survival sandbox game.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: The U3 SDK provides the complete C# source code and development environment for Unturned, a popular free-to-play open-world zombie survival game. It allows developers and modders to deeply explore the game's architecture, make extensive code changes, and create custom content natively within the Unity editor. The SDK requires the Unity 2022.3.62f3 editor and a legal, installed copy of the game via Steam, as it dynamically loads the game's large binary assets and mods directly from that installation. This environment serves as the primary resource for creating advanced, code-driven modifications and understanding the complex internal mechanics of a successful multiplayer sandbox game.
keyFeatures: Full source access: Provides the complete C# source code for the Unturned game logic, enabling deep architectural understanding.
Native Unity integration: Designed to be opened, edited, and run directly within the standard Unity 2022 editor environment.
Dynamic Steam dependency: Efficiently loads large binary assets and mods from the local Steam installation to minimize repository size.
Visual Studio support: Supports full C# code editing and debugging via standard .NET desktop development tools and IDEs.
Advanced modding foundation: Serves as the base framework for creating complex, code-driven game modifications beyond simple asset replacements.

useCases.title: Custom Mod Creation

useCases.title: Architecture Study
useCases.description: Developers analyze the source code to understand how a large-scale Unity multiplayer game is structured and optimized.

useCases.title: Asset Integration
useCases.description: Creators test their custom 3D models and textures within the actual game environment using the familiar Unity editor workflow.

useCases.title: Community Bug Fixing
useCases.description: Community members identify issues in the provided source code, test fixes locally, and propose solutions or workarounds.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This SDK is designed for game developers and Unturned modders who want to create advanced custom content, write C# modifications, or study the architecture of a successful Unity-based sandbox game.
